integrity: The universal statement is supported by an analytic Schur-complement and conditional-Gaussian proof. Finite exact-rational computations are supplementary consistency checks, not proof of the infinite claim. Literature comparisons are limited to the inspected sources and targeted searches, with residual risk explicitly recorded.
scientific_limitations: Three standardized Gaussian coordinates only; one negative exponent -alpha with 0<alpha<1 and two quadratic factors. No claim is made for nonquadratic positive exponents, higher dimension, or non-Gaussian laws.
title: Sharp fixed-edge envelope for a mixed-sign Gaussian square product
